verdict.rationale: Datadog has a dedicated first-party OpenTelemetry integration page describing OTLP ingestion and standard OTel instrumentation support, which is the core mechanism enabling 'instrument once, send anywhere' portability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actually switching backends without re-instrumentation, and details on OTel semantic-convention fidelity or any gaps versus Datadog-proprietary tracer features.
